## Dashboard goal

The dashboard should help a stakeholder understand the main patterns without needing to read a long report.

## Planned content

1. A small number of clearly defined summary measures
2. A trend chart for changes over time
3. Relevant group comparisons
4. Notes explaining limitations and definitions

The final design will use validated data and will avoid treating associations as proof of causation.
